notes: Revision 2 per-chapter machine-readable hooks. Effects/conditions use the dialogue schema (SCHEMA.md). chapter_start_effects run before the first scene; chapter_end_effects after the last. No medical-clock checkpoints exist in Revision 2. Every chapter has a season (late_summer | autumn | late_fall | nuclear_winter; see seasons{}). Act III adds the Hollows (assimilation{}). 'levels' lists the level files that implement a chapter (Ch7 spans two).

looter.desc: Desperate civilians stealing. Flee when hurt or threatened. Melee/pistol.

watch_militia.desc: Block-watch neighbors (Deputy Lusk's crew) with deer rifles. Neutral unless provoked or you carry stolen goods.

bridge_boy.desc: Laid-off warehouse kids and motel residents from under the I-80 viaduct. Pipes, pistols, molotovs. Break and run at 50% losses.

desperate_family.desc: Armed parent defending kids (Pete Lund). Only hostile if threatened. Killing one: kindness -2, carly trust -2.

authority_guard.desc: County + Nevada Guard. Rifles, vests. Neutral unless you're hostile to the Authority.

compact_militia.desc: Fallon and Mason Valley ranchers. Deer rifles, hay trucks. Hostility depends on convoy_choice.

harbor_militia.desc: Casino workers with rifles. Hostile only if bridge_choice=open.

ironwood_patrol.desc: Federal Army fireteam (4). Rifles, NVGs at night. Avoidable; some surrender if outflanked.

ironwood_checkpoint.desc: Static: sandbags, searchlight, MG. Sneak, use ironwood_id, or assault.

ironwood_drone.desc: Small surveillance quadcopter. Calls fire after 3 s LOS. Fog/blizzard ground it.

ironwood_mrap.desc: Armored truck with searchlight/MG. Not killable by small arms.

ironwood_bradley.desc: IFV in the Reno rail trench (Ch6). Never fought directly. Block with the freight car (freight_car_drop) or let pass.

remnant_patrol.desc: Kessler's loyalists after Ch7. Better gear, low ammo, cold. Can stand down in Ch10.

recovery_detail.desc: NEW. Stranded, starving Ironwood squad (6) at the Dixie Valley Annex under SFC Brandt. Hostile by default; talked down by Ruiz, ironwood_id, or food. Variant of remnant_patrol stats at 60% HP.

feral_dog.desc: Abandoned pets turned pack (3-5). Flee fire and flares.

coyote.desc: NEW (replaces wolf). Smaller, faster than feral dogs; packs of 3-5 on the flats and creek. Flee flares.

husk.desc: Radiation-sick, hypothermic, starving PEOPLE. Not infected, not monsters, and NOT Hollows: they breathe (visible plume), talk in their own words, and Wraith whines softly at them. Rush heat/food. Talk-down: iodide_tablets + wool_blanket + kindness>=4. Tallmen follow husks.

assimilated_human.desc: NEW (Act III). A person a Tallman fed on and kept. In-world: a Hollow. Wears the victim's clothes and voice: repeats half-remembered phrases off-cadence ('Let me in, I have filters', 'Braith?', 'Morning, neighbor', 'Open the gate'). Wrong gait and joint angles; neck turns past the shoulders. Draws warmth: NO breath plume in the cold. Knocks at doors and calls from the ash; lunges when a door opens or the player turns away. Flees sustained light like a Tallman. Wraith growls low with hackles up and refuses to approach (vs a soft whine at a real husk).
voice_lines: Let me in. I have filters.
Over here. I found the trail.

assimilated_animal.desc: NEW (Act III). Assimilated coyotes, dogs and livestock. Silent (no yips), no breath plume, move in step like one animal with too many legs; wait instead of circling. Stalk river_ice and the Galena perimeter in packs of 3-5; test floodlight poles. Flee flares. Wraith goes silent and puts herself between them and Braith.

tallman.desc: NEW. Escaped LONG SLEEP subject from the Dixie Valley Annex. 7-8 ft, ash-grey, flat reflective eyes. Seeks heat; retreats from sustained light (flashlight cone 2 s, flare radius, floodlight); hit-and-retreat; max 3 active anywhere; disengages after losing 2 or at dawn. Never a horde. Engine: on each kill add tallmen_killed +1.

tallman_glimpse.desc: NEW. Non-interactable silhouette billboard at long range (>=80 m). No collider, no AI, no HUD cue, no music sting. Requires LOS to player; despawns after duration, on approach (<60 m) or LOS loss. Triggers Wraith's stare/whine. on_show: tallman_glimpses +1.

verbs.track: Follow a scent from an item (pruitt_scarf) or blood trail; paw-print trail; finds caches/people.
verbs.warn: Automatic growl/freeze/stare before enemies are visible; points at Tallmen first. Bark direction = threat side in Ch10.
verbs.guard: Posted at a door/camp: reduces theft and break-ins; +SEAL integrity at night.
verbs.hold: Pins ONE human enemy. Refuses Tallmen (backs away, ears flat).

companion.down_rule: At 0 HP Wraith is DOWN, never dead: set wraith_injured=true, carried (player speed -15%) or on the sled; recovers next chapter or with vet_kit.
companion.death_rule: wraith_alive=false ONLY via dialogue/ch09_wraith_hold choice '[Order Wraith to hold the line]' + explicit confirmation. validate.py enforces this.
companion.injured: wraith_injured=true: limps, no TRACK, still WARNs. Cleared by vet_kit or a full rest at a warm shelter.

barter.note: Each trader has wants[] (x0.7 price when paying in a wanted good) and a rep flag trader_<id>_rep (+1 per fair trade/quest). See npcs.json traders[].

enc_ch01_watch_standoff.note: Wraith steps in front; ends if you holster or run.

enc_ch03_fire_rescue.note: house_fire heat hazard; carry Gil out.

enc_ch04_ramp_chase.note: Tug chase off the ramp; no kills required.

enc_ch05_compact_attack.note: Escort path. Sets fired_on_blockade via dialogue.

enc_ch07_road_tallman.note: FIRST Tallman fight. Light pushes it back; it retreats wounded.

enc_ch07_tolliver.note: Single armed guard (use authority_guard stats). Only if you fire.

enc_ch07_holds_tallman.note: Wing A corridor; flees to the flooded stair.

enc_ch08_husk.note: A sick man. Not a monster.

enc_ch08_hollow_first.note: FIRST Hollow: Dale Henley in his kitchen (ch08_henley_house). Interior, flashlight only. Sets up the paranoia.

enc_ch08_door_mimic.note: Only if the player opens the door to the midnight knock (ch08_door). Close quarters in the hallway; SEAL drops while open.

enc_ch09_hollow_ambush.note: Whiteout voice ambush (ch09_voices): a Hollow calls in Walt's voice off the rope line. Following it costs one column member.

enc_ch09_animal_pack.note: Assimilated coyote pack on river_ice (ch09_voices). Silent; flee flares; break off after losing 2.

enc_ch09_ice_tallmen.note: Max 3; they test, then break off after losing 1.

enc_ch10_siege_n1.note: Repair a cut lamp cable while watched. Usually no attack.

enc_ch10_siege_n2.note: Clamp the cooling-water line under the lights.

enc_ch10_hollow_prowlers.note: Siege night 2 (ch10_siege_night2): Hollows call names from past the lamp line; animal prowlers test each pole's dark edge. Night 3 reuses their voice barks between lamps.

enc_ch10_siege_n3.note: Push on one side (if den_killed and tallmen_killed>=3) or two. Disengage after losing 2 or at dawn.

enc_ch10_gate_battle.note: Only if the Remnant doesn't stand down.

locations.loc_sparks_block: Braith and Carly's block, old Sparks near Prater Way. HUD SECTOR 4. Lolo's clinic, Gil's garage, the Pruitts.
locations.loc_prater_pharmacy: Corner pharmacy on Prater Way. Looted Day 2.
locations.loc_sparks_marina: Sparks Marina lake. Ch1 water run (interactive ch01_lake_edge).
locations.loc_virginia_bridge: Virginia Street bridge over the Truckee. Authority checkpoint (Cpl. Haas).
locations.loc_rscc_registry: Reno-Sparks Convention Center: registry, ration hall, Annie's table, Ruth's class; Avila's command post in Ch6.
locations.loc_meadows_general: Truckee Meadows General Hospital (fictional). Dr. Ames. Parking ramp level 3 tanker.
locations.loc_fourth_street: 4th Street motel row and Silver State Pawn (Dutch). Viaduct Crew turf. Marsh's motel (Ch6).
locations.loc_sparks_yard: Union Pacific yard, Sparks. Convoys; Boone's back door; Remnant base in Act III.
locations.loc_silver_spur: The Silver Spur, a dead downtown casino (fictional). The Floor's HQ and kitchens; Carly's Switchboard in Ch6.
locations.loc_sparks_library: Sparks library on Pyramid Way. Annie's seed library; glass atrium greenhouse (Act III).
locations.loc_airguard_ramp: Air Guard ramp, Reno-Tahoe Airport. C-130s parked in rows; -86 ground power carts by Hangar 2.
locations.loc_tric_warehouses: Industrial-center warehouses east of Sparks. Ch5 convoy staging; Darlene's reefer trailer.
locations.loc_mustang_truckstop: Truck stop at the I-80 Mustang exit. Mo's fuel market.
locations.loc_i80_blockade: I-80 in the Truckee canyon east of Sparks. Compact blockade, rail signal cabinet, overpass.
locations.loc_rail_trench: The sunken rail trench through downtown Reno. Bradley set piece; freight car on the siding; the alley glimpse.
locations.loc_peavine_shack: Augie's radio shack under the repeater towers on Peavine Peak.
locations.loc_us50_fallon: US-50 into Fallon. Compact checkpoint at the canal bridge (Ross). The last 'normal' town.
locations.loc_dixie_annex: Dixie Valley Annex exterior: fence, guard shack (Tolliver), airstrip, hangar (recovery detail, cage four).
locations.loc_annex_holds: Annex interior: maglock corridor, Wing A torpor holds (all forced open), records room, stair to flooded/collapsed Wing B.
locations.loc_dixie_hotsprings: Hot springs 3 mi north of the Annex. Optional den: two Tallmen in torpor.
locations.loc_steamboat_creek: Steamboat Creek corridor and hot-spring vents. Salt's culvert. Approach to Galena.
locations.loc_galena_station: Galena Station geothermal plant (fictional, at the Steamboat field): well field, steam, break room, control room, fence and lamp line.
locations.river_ice: The frozen Truckee from Sparks east to the Steamboat Creek confluence. Ch9 blizzard march; Glendale bridge picket.

late_summer.survival: hydration, heat, spoiled food, dust. No warmth/cold pressure.
late_summer.palette: warm amber dust, white sun glare, heat shimmer
late_summer.notes: Blackout in late-summer heat: no AC, fridges dead, marina water run. No frost, snow, coats or cold breath.

autumn.survival: warmth starts to bite at night; fuel and heating worries.
autumn.palette: autumn gold, yellow cottonwoods along the Truckee, long shadows
autumn.notes: Crisp high-desert autumn; first cold nights; dry wind.

late_fall.survival: warmth dominates; wet cold, biting wind.
late_fall.palette: overcast slate grey, wet asphalt, sodium-orange dead lamps
late_fall.notes: Civil war. First sleet and frost on Peavine and US-50. Cold desert nights at the Annex. Dec 5 bursts turn the sky brown; grey ash flakes fall.

nuclear_winter.survival: warmth, radiation, filters, SEAL; survival horror (Hollows).
nuclear_winter.palette: ashfall blue-grey, near-monochrome; floodlight cones and flare red are the only warm colors
nuclear_winter.notes: Fallout rain → thick ashfall → whiteout blizzards; frozen Truckee (river_ice). Tone shifts to grounded survival horror; endings stay dark-but-hopeful.

assimilation.rule: Tallmen feed on warmth and keep what's left: assimilated people and animals (Hollows) stalk the ash for them. Husks are still living, sick people and must stay distinct.

tells.wraith: Hollow: low growl, hackles up, refuses to approach (sets wraith_mimic_warned). Real husk or stranger: soft whine, noses their hand.
tells.breath: Hollows show NO breath plume in sub-zero air; living people always do (render a plume on every living NPC in Act III).
tells.voice: Copied phrases, off-cadence and repeated; the voice can belong to someone who is provably elsewhere.
tells.gait: Wrong joint angles; the neck keeps turning after the shoulders stop.
tells.light: Eyes reflect flat in a flashlight, like a Tallman's.

assimilation.foreshadow: Ch7: annex_log's water-swollen 'TISSUE INTEGRATION' page and Reyne's line in ch07_annex_holds (node many2). Nothing explicit before Ch8.
assimilation.count_rule: No Tallman or Hollow totals are ever stated. tallmen_killed and assimilated_killed are separate counters.
